title.narrative: The Eastern Kafue Alliance for Nature and Prosperity

description.narrative: (Zambia): The Eastern Kafue Nature Alliance (EKNA) aims to achieve biodiversity.conservation and cross-cutting outcomes in food security, nutrition, health,.water, and sanitation in the Greater Kafue Landscape (GKL), which includes.Kafue National Park, Zambia's largest protected area. Unsustainable agriculture,.poaching, overfishing, deforestation, and habitat degradation are major threats.to the biodiversity of the GKL. With FY 2022 funds, EKNA, a partnership with.private sector entities Kashikoto Conservancy Limited and Amatheon AGRI Zambia.Limited, will promote inclusive natural resources governance and support.wildlife and forestry law enforcement, agricultural productivity,.entrepreneurship, and increased access to safe water and maternal and child.health (MCH) services. With FY 2022 funds, the EKNA will provide both training.and technical support to strengthen farmers to adopt more productive climate.resilient agricultural technologies to increase productivity, reduce labor and.water needs, and create empowered, climate-resilient farmers. Private-sector.partnerships will also provide agronomic extension and facilitate linkages to.output markets. EKNA will also harness over $11 million of private sector.leveraged resources and strengthen community natural resources governance.institutions to partner with various stakeholders for improving socio-economic,.health, food security, nutrition, forestry, and wildlife conservation.conditions. This will, in turn, strengthen disincentives for illegal.exploitation of natural resources, while increasing incentives for proper.stewardship and community buy-in to the GKL's biodiversity, thereby improving.and stabilizing long-term economic and livelihood opportunities. EKNA supports.Development Objectives 2 and 3 of the USAID Zambia Country Development.Cooperation Strategy. ...
